correctness.rationale: For every integer \(m\ge3\), the exact vertex and edge illumination definitions are checked. The nonstandard endpoint lemma follows from the two active edge normals at each vertex. Equispaced open arcs have lengths between \((k-1)\Delta\) and \(k\Delta\) and at most \(k\)-fold overlap; cyclic block-midpoint directions with mass \(1/k\) cover each vertex. For odd-sided perturbations, deviations \(\eta<\Delta/4\) preserve both the \(q\)-overlap obstruction and all \(q\)-block midpoint incidences. Strict endpoint conventions are respected. The exact rational checker was run on its actual bundled source with `VERIFY_OK` and 738 assertions, supplementary to the universal analytic proof.

value.rationale: The object is Naszódi’s and Gorodzha’s natural fractional illumination number, a geometric optimization invariant. The theorem gives a uniform exact parity-sensitive spectrum for all equiangular polygons with nonuniform edge lengths, and an explicit open angular neighborhood for every odd m with unchanged optimum. The matching fractional obstruction and optimal direction construction illuminate structural independence from support lengths. This is more than a routine restatement of general upper bounds or a small finite table.
